title: Reproducible evaluation cohorts and comparisons
description:
Purpose: Make every baseline, candidate, synthesis, and resumed evaluation comparison reproducible by preserving exact cohort identity, coverage, and provenance.

Exclusions:
- Changing feedback labels or client review policy.
- Replacing the canonical feedback evaluator.
- Silently substituting an unbalanced or independently selected cohort.

Dependencies: Supplies frozen cohort and provenance contracts to candidate safety, observability, and orchestration. Cohort work can proceed independently.

Definition of Done:
- Historical balancing considers every reachable output class and reports coverage.
- Recent and regression baseline cohorts are materialized or otherwise replayable with exact ordered membership.
- Fresh, candidate, synthesis, and resumed evaluations use the same applicable cohort.
- Missing provenance or replay failures fail closed.
- Explicit local dataset replay uses the canonical evaluation pipeline.
- Behavior-first specifications and focused tests pass.

Running log: Preserve existing issue histories and record sanitized decisions, attempts, outcomes, and next steps in this epic or its child issues.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Starting isolated implementation for frozen recent-feedback cohort replay. Scope: retain ordered reviewed-item membership after baseline selection; require candidate and synthesis feedback evaluations to reuse it; expose provenance; fail closed when replay cannot be performed. Existing child issue is maintained in a separate active worktree, so no duplicate is being created here.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented and verified stricter frozen recent-feedback cohort replay in the isolated worktree. Candidate, strategy, and synthesis comparisons now fail if returned cohort membership is reordered, in addition to existing missing-provenance and membership checks. Focused specifications passed (4 tests); only existing deprecation warnings were emitted.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Wave 1 integration landed exact ordered recent-feedback replay and regression dataset identity checks. Candidate, strategy, and synthesis comparisons fail closed when frozen cohort provenance differs. Combined focused and full supported-runtime CI passed.
